# RotateMesh <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Meshes](Blitz3D-Meshes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RotateMesh:Void mesh:Int32, pitch:Float32, yaw:Float32, roll:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mesh` | In | Int32 | required | Mesh handle. |
| `pitch` | In | Float32 | required | Rotation around X in degrees. |
| `yaw` | In | Float32 | required | Rotation around Y in degrees. |
| `roll` | In | Float32 | required | Rotation around Z in degrees. |

## Description

Turns every vertex of a mesh around the origin, permanently. The angles are in degrees. It is how you stand a model upright or tilt a part before merging it with [AddMesh](AddMesh).
